name: SenClaw CRM
description: A CRM Space App that runs the whole customer lifecycle in one process. CONTACTS — profile, avatar, tags, 13 roles, notes, their own contact channels (phone/email/Zalo/Facebook/…), plus a chronological log of every touchpoint. ORGANIZATIONS — accounts a contact belongs to (0..n, one primary, which also syncs the contact's company text); kinds: direct_customer, affiliated_company, partner, supplier, prospect. SERVICES — the sellable catalogue (service|hardware, pricing_model fixed|hourly|daily|monthly|yearly), attached to deals as line items with a frozen unit price; a deal's value is recomputed from its lines. DEALS across the Kanban pipeline (qualifying → proposal → negotiation → won/lost), TASKS + an upcoming feed (due tasks + birthdays), and a directed RELATIONSHIP GRAPH with BFS path-finding, similar-contact ranking and AI extraction from notes. INBOX — real multi-channel messaging over our connected accounts (telegram, zalo, facebook, tiktok, websocket), polled rather than webhooked; an inbound message's external_id resolves against the contact's known identities to auto-link the thread. PROACTIVE SALES (absorbed from the standalone AI Sale app) — sales state lives on the customer row itself (sale_stage new_lead→engaged→qualified→consult_scheduled→consult_done→closed_won|churned, temperature, lead_score, unsubscribed); there is no leads table and no lead_id, everything keys on customer_id. GUARDRAIL — sale_send is the only path to a customer's inbox and is enforced in Rust, fail-closed: unsubscribed is blocked outright with no override, exceeding the 24h touch limit queues for human review, and price/contract wording queues for human review (replies held to a stricter bar than broadcasts). DYNAMIC DASHBOARD — user-defined charts on top of an ad-hoc analytics surface (crm_query): pick an element (contact|organization|deal|service|task = what one row is), a metric (count | dealValue = summed money of related deals | dealQuantity = summed service line-item quantity), an optional grouping field to split by, and filters, and get back buckets with numbers — no row-listing-and-counting. crm_dashboard_schema publishes which elements carry which metrics (task has only count; contact/organization have no dealQuantity) and which fields are groupable or filterable with which operators; unknown field keys are rejected rather than ignored, dates are deliberately not groupable, and the inLastDays operator is evaluated at query time so a saved chart keeps meaning 'the last 30 days'. FTS5 diacritic-folded full-text search across everything, AI briefings per contact and across the whole CRM, revenue breakdown by organization and service kind, and calendar sync with the Space Calendar app.

mcp.name: crm-mcp
mcp.description: SenClaw CRM MCP — 83 tools covering 100% of the app's read and write surface. CONTACTS (13 roles: lead, prospect, customer, vip, contact, partner, referrer, supplier, investor, employee, former, paused, lost) with avatar (URL or base64), tags, notes; their contact channels (phone, email, zalo, facebook, linkedin, instagram, x, tiktok, youtube, github, telegram, whatsapp, signal, line, wechat, skype, viber, discord, messenger, website); interactions (call/email/meeting/note/task). ORGANIZATIONS — list/get/find/create/update/delete plus link/unlink a contact (0..n orgs, one primary, which syncs the contact's company text); kinds direct_customer|affiliated_company|partner|supplier|prospect; ALWAYS crm_find_organization before crm_create_organization. SERVICES — the service|hardware catalogue with pricing_model fixed|hourly|daily|monthly|yearly, attached to deals as line items (crm_attach_service/crm_detach_service/crm_deal_services) with a frozen unit_amount; a deal's amount is recomputed from its lines; crm_delete_service FAILS when it prices a deal — deactivate with crm_update_service{active:false} instead. DEALS across the Kanban pipeline (qualifying → proposal → negotiation → won/lost), TASKS + reminders + upcoming feed (birthdays + due tasks). RELATIONSHIP GRAPH (11 kinds: referred_by, introduced_by, colleague_of, spouse_of, family_of, friend_of, reports_to, partner_of, supplier_of, competitor_of, contact_of) with BFS shortest path, AI qualitative connections, similar-contact ranking, AI graph extraction from notes, AI common-theme discovery. INBOX — crm_list_conversations/crm_get_conversation/crm_link_conversation/crm_list_inbox_channels over our connected accounts (telegram|zalo|facebook|tiktok|websocket, polled, credentials redacted); customer_id=0 means an unlinked thread, and linking one also records the platform identity so future messages auto-resolve. PROACTIVE SALES — everything keys on customer_id; there is NO leads table, NO lead_id and NO sale_capture_lead (use crm_create_customer with role 'lead'). Sales state lives on the customer row: sale_stage (new_lead|engaged|qualified|consult_scheduled|consult_done|closed_won|churned — distinct from deals.stage, which tracks ONE opportunity), temperature (cold|warm|hot|churned), lead_score, unsubscribed. sale_next_action runs one agentic proactive turn; sale_draft_message previews without sending; sale_update_stage, sale_escalate, sale_start_sequence (welcome|nurture|re_engage|winback), sale_schedule_followup, sale_unsubscribe, sale_list_inbox (review + escalation queues), sale_approve_review/sale_reject_review, sale_resolve_escalation, sale_pipeline_report. GUARDRAIL — sale_send is THE ONLY SEND PATH; no raw channel send is exposed. Enforced in Rust, fail-closed, first match wins: unsubscribed → BLOCKED (no override, not even via approve-from-review); over max_messages_per_customer_24h (default 3) delivered touches → REVIEW; risky price/contract wording → REVIEW (reply ≥1 keyword, broadcast ≥2), matched diacritic-folded. Welcome enrolment is gated by the auto_welcome setting, OFF by default, and fires only for role 'lead'. DYNAMIC DASHBOARD + AD-HOC ANALYTICS — crm_query answers any 'how many / how much / broken down by X' question WITHOUT listing rows and counting them (a list is capped by its limit; crm_query sees every row). Spec: element (contact|organization|deal|service|task = what one row is) + metric (count | dealValue = summed money of related deals | dealQuantity = summed service line-item quantity) + optional grouping (a field key to split by; omit for a single total) + filters ([{field, op, values[]}], ANDed). Not every element has every metric — task has ONLY count, contact/organization have NO dealQuantity; asking for a missing one is an error, not a zero. Counts are COUNT(DISTINCT pk) so a join never inflates them. Groupable fields: contact — role, sale_stage, temperature, source, unsubscribed, organization (the PRIMARY org only); organization — kind, industry, size; deal — stage, currency, organization, contact; service — kind, pricing_model, currency, active; task — status, contact. Filter-only (NOT groupable): lead_score, amount, probability, and every date (created_at, updated_at, expected_close_at, due_at) — dates are deliberately not groupable, so there is no 'by month' grouping; bound the window with a date FILTER and group by something categorical instead. Operators by field kind — enum/text/relation: in|notIn|isNull|isNotNull; bool: in (values 0|1); number/date: gt|gte|lt|lte|between|inLastDays. A mismatched operator is rejected, not coerced. Dates are Unix SECONDS; inLastDays takes a DAY COUNT and is evaluated at query time, so a saved chart keeps meaning 'the last 30 days' rather than freezing a date. notIn deliberately includes NULL/blank rows (the human reading of 'stage not in lost'); an empty in/notIn value list is treated as no filter. crm_dashboard_schema publishes the live registry (elements, metrics, groupable/filterable fields, operators, value vocabularies, display types, sizes) — CALL IT BEFORE GUESSING A FIELD KEY: an unknown key is REJECTED, not ignored, and there is no assignee/owner/lead_id field. Result: {rows:[{bucket,value}], total, groups, is_money, filter_summary} sorted value DESC then bucket; an empty bucket string means the value is unset (no primary org, no currency), and an ungrouped query returns one row with bucket ''. crm_list_charts returns the saved charts each WITH its numbers already computed; crm_create_chart persists a query as a chart (name, element, metric, grouping, filters, display_type verticalBarChart|horizontalBarChart|verticalBarChartWithLabels|horizontalBarChartWithLabels|doughnutChart|radarChart, size small|medium|large) and VALIDATES by compiling the spec, so an invalid chart fails at save time instead of rendering an error card forever; crm_delete_chart removes one (confirm first). Save a chart only for a query someone wants repeatedly — a one-off question is just crm_query. Prefer the purpose-built reports where they already fit: crm_stats (dashboard totals), crm_revenue_breakdown (value by organization + service kind), sale_pipeline_report (funnel, win rate, queue depths). FTS5 diacritic-folded full-text search across all data, per-contact and whole-CRM AI briefings, revenue breakdown by organization and service kind, calendar sync with the Space Calendar app.

personas.name: crm-assistant
personas.description: A friendly, precise CRM assistant that keeps contacts, organizations, the service catalogue, deals and the inbox accurate, drafts outreach from real stored context, answers 'how many / how much / by X' with crm_query instead of paging rows and counting by hand, and never fabricates who someone is or what something costs.

personas.name: sale-closer
personas.description: Trợ lý chốt sale chủ động bên trong CRM — đọc thẳng hồ sơ, công ty, deal và mạng lưới của khách; cá nhân hoá theo ngữ cảnh thật, không bịa giá/cam kết; hỏi giá/hợp đồng thì escalate; khiếu nại thì escalate ngay. Mọi tin gửi đi chỉ qua sale_send.

personas.name: sale-manager
personas.description: Quản lý sale — giám sát pipeline, duyệt hàng chờ (review), xử lý escalation, đọc win-rate và điều phối chăm sóc; kiểm chứng mọi con số với bảng giá và line item của deal trước khi duyệt.
